item.text: {"analysis":"The candidate completed all 60 epochs successfully, with its best checkpoint at epoch 40. Validation HR@10 was 0.635; HR@5/20 were 0.520/0.735, and NDCG@10 was 0.42762. This establishes a successful run, but without a comparison baseline it does not establish that gating, factorization, or residual scaling improved accuracy. Small learned residual scales may help stabilize the deep stack, while gated local and dilated paths provide complementary context.","code_summary":"One causal NextItNet with 64-dimensional, position-free item embeddings and eight independently parameterized blocks using dilations [1,2,4,8,1,2,4,8]. Each block mixes a full dilated convolution with a depthwise local convolution followed by pointwise mixing through a learned channel-wise gate, initially 0.5. A second full dilated convolution completes the branch; learned per-channel residual scales start at 0.1. Uses pre-layer normalization, GELU, dropout 0.2, padding masks, final layer normalization, and tied item-embedding dot-product scoring. MAXLEN=128, kernel size=3, LR=0.001, weight decay=0, batch size=128."}
